exposure: Preterm birth (PTB) (stratified into early and late PTB)
outcome: 75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) results
cohort: The study included 14,314 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered at a hospital in Fujian Province, China, between January 2018 and December 2021.
finding: Preterm birth in women with GDM was associated with a higher prevalence of premature rupture of membranes, hypertensive diseases of pregnancy, intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, anemia, and cervical insufficiency, with early preterm birth also showing distinct lipid and inflammatory profiles compared to late preterm birth.
gest_age: Preterm birth (<37 weeks), stratified into early PTB (<34 weeks) and late PTB (34-36 weeks), and term birth (>37 weeks).
